results.title: Laos, Russian Region of Tatarstan Discuss New Trade Opportunities
results.content: Russia’s Republic of Tatarstan wants to expand trade and investment with Laos, with the region’s official media describing current economic ties as “practically absent” during a two-day visit by its head to Vientiane on 4 and 5 November.
